cases.sentence: После этого я увидел еще одного ___, сходящего с небес.
cases.translation: After this I saw another angel coming down out of the sky.
cases.explain: The verb увидел (saw) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: The whole earth was illuminated by his glory.
cases.explain: The noun земля is the subject of the verb была (was), so it stands in nominative case.

cases.translation: Babylon the great prostitute has fallen.
cases.explain: The place name is in apposition to the subject and stands in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Все народы пили доводящее до безумия ___ ее разврата.
cases.translation: All the nations have drunk the wine of her sexual immorality.
cases.explain: The verb пить (to drink) is transitive and takes the accusative case for what is drunk.

cases.sentence: В той самой ___, в которой она замешивала свое вино, замешайте ей напиток.
cases.translation: In the same cup in which she mixed her wine, mix her a drink.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location meaning uses the prepositional case.

cases.translation: She will be burned by fire.
cases.explain: The verb сожжена (burnt) in passive voice takes the instrumental case for the agent of the action.

cases.sentence: Затем могучий ангел взял большой ___ размером с мельничный жернов.
cases.translation: Then a mighty angel took a great stone the size of a millstone.
cases.explain: The verb взял (took) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: And threw it into the sea.
cases.explain: The preposition в with accusative indicates the destination where something is thrown.

reading.ru: После этого я увидел еще одного ангела, сходящего с небес и обладающего великой властью.
reading.question: What was the angel descending from heaven like?
reading.explain: The text says ангел, сходящего с небес и обладающего великой властью (an angel coming down out of the sky and having great authority).

reading.ru: Вся земля была озарена его славой.
reading.question: What did the angel's glory do to the earth?
reading.explain: The text states Вся земля была озарена его славой (The whole earth was illuminated by his glory).

reading.ru: Пала! Пала великая блудница Вавилон и стала жилищем демонов!
reading.question: What did Babylon become after falling?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states Пала великая блудница Вавилон и стала жилищем демонов (Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she became a habitation of demons).

reading.ru: Все народы пили доводящее до безумия вино ее разврата.
reading.question: What did all the nations drink?
options: The maddening wine of her sexual immorality
reading.correct: The maddening wine of her sexual immorality
reading.explain: The text says Все народы пили доводящее до безумия вино ее разврата (All nations drank the maddening wine of her sexual immorality).

reading.ru: Выйди из нее, народ мой, чтобы тебе не участвовать в ее грехах и не подвергнуться ее наказанию.
reading.question: Why was God's people told to leave Babylon?
options: So they would not share in her sins and plagues
So they could build a new city
So they could fight her enemies
reading.correct: So they would not share in her sins and plagues
reading.explain: The text says выйди из нее, чтобы не участвовать в ее грехах и не подвергнуться ее наказанию (come out of her, that you might not share in her sins and plagues).

reading.ru: Затем могучий ангел взял большой камень размером с мельничный жернов и бросил его в море, говоря, «Так будет брошена и великая столица Вавилон».
reading.question: What did the angel do with the stone?
options: Threw it into the sea as a sign of Babylon's destruction
Held it up in the sky
reading.correct: Threw it into the sea as a sign of Babylon's destruction
reading.explain: The text describes the angel taking a stone and бросил его в море (threw it into the sea) as a sign of how Babylon will be destroyed.
